title: Expertise
text:
Expertise

Expertise

Quantitative methods, built for application. The details of our work are in our publications and notes.




Methods
01Statistics and econometricsWe develop statistical methods for testing the reliability of risk models. We assess how well their predictions match observed outcomes and whether they hold up as the data change.Jeffreys calibration testContinuous monitoring
02Machine learning and artificial intelligenceWe develop and evaluate machine learning models to analyse and predict risk. We test how well they perform on new data and whether their predictions are interpretable.


03Stress testing and scenariosWe design stress tests to measure how adverse scenarios affect portfolios. We identify which exposures are most vulnerable and which risk factors drive losses.Reverse stress testCredit stress test
Applications
Credit riskDeveloping, validating and monitoring credit models, and measuring how they behave under stress.Climate risksBringing physical and transition risks into the assessment of financial risk.Geopolitical and macro-financial riskUnderstanding how shocks spread to portfolios, and which ones could put them in difficulty.

title: About
text:
The collective



STORM is a quantitative research collective of Square Management: a team of researchers and consultants developing methods to measure, anticipate and manage risk.

title: About
text:
Who we are
STORM brings together researchers and consultants with complementary backgrounds: statistics, econometrics, economics, data science and machine learning.
This dual culture, academic and operational, is at the heart of how we work: the questions come from the field, the answers come through method.

title: About
text:
What we do
We develop quantitative models and methods to measure, anticipate and manage risk. Our current work focuses mainly on financial risk, but the methods are designed to transfer to other fields.
We submit research papers to peer-reviewed journals and publish technical notes that explain how to apply our methods.

title: About
text:
How we work
Method first. Rigorous tools with clear statistical guarantees.
Built for application. Every method is put to the test on real problems and fits into existing set-ups.
Open to discussion. Our work is published, presented at conferences and open to the scrutiny of the academic community. Our methods are also presented to operational teams, who test them against their own practice.

title: About
text:
Work with us
Together with Square Management’s consulting teams, we support financial institutions on their risk modelling and risk management challenges: from model design to validation, from stress testing to team training.
A project, a question, a presentation request: write to us.

contact@squaremanagement-storm.com


STORM is part of Square Management and the Square Research Center.
